audit_name: One-Step Target Leakage and Invariance Audit

pm25_temporal_variation_in_fixture.explanation: In the Phase 2 NetCDF generation fixture, PM2.5 was computed from a spatial Gaussian plume modulated by a diurnal factor that evaluates to 1.0. Consequently, PM2.5 in every cell was static in time. This caused the true 1-hour transition to be x(t+1) == x(t), which explains why the 1-hour MAE was 0.0, RMSE was 0.0, R2 was 1.0, and why DMDc matched Persistence RMSE identically!

status: PASS (No architectural or mathematical leakage; static PM2.5 fixture explained)
